policy.rule_mirror: A reference image may be committed under gallery/reference/images/ ONLY when its record's display_permission == APPROVED and mirror.sha256_verified == true (sha256 must equal image_sha256 = the audited upstream bytes).
policy.rule_site: The website/README may render a reference image ONLY from an APPROVED, mirrored record; otherwise they render a labeled link-out card (never a placeholder image pretending to be the reference).
policy.rule_model: Reference images are never labeled as verified GPT Image 2 output; label: 'Community Gallery Reference — Model Unverified'.
policy.rule_count: All published 'N references × M Qwen' counts must be derived from this ledger at build time; hardcoding is a CI failure.
policy.rule_pinned_source: All upstream facts pinned to source_commit_sha; changing the pin requires re-audit.
